guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：無伺服器執行平台
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Serverless execution platforms
guides.concept: 以函式生命週期、microVM 與彈性成本連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect function lifecycles, microvms and elasticity costs through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「執行契約」的資料、控制與時間關係。函式介面需定義輸入、輸出及逾時。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對正常與失敗回應。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「多租戶隔離」的資料、控制與時間關係。隔離需管理記憶體、網路與 CPU。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「建立租戶資源矩陣。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「快照啟動」的資料、控制與時間關係。還原需考慮時間、隨機性及秘密狀態。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「列出不可盲目複用的資料。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「擴展延遲」的資料、控制與時間關係。增加容量有延遲而非瞬間完成。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「加入突發與擴展準備窗口。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「重試去重」的資料、控制與時間關係。事件重送需防重複業務副作用。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「建立虛構 idempotency key。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「SLO 驗收」的資料、控制與時間關係。平均並行不足以證明尾端延遲。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「對突發工作負載看分位數。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for execution contracts. Function interfaces define input, output and timeout. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check normal and failed responses. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for multitenant isolation. Isolation governs memory, networks and CPU. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Build a tenant-resource matrix. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for snapshot startup. Restore considers clocks, randomness and secret state. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: List state unsuitable for blind reuse. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for scaling delay. Capacity growth takes time. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Add burst and scaling-readiness windows. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for retry deduplication. Redelivery needs duplicate-effect prevention. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Construct a fictional idempotency key. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for slo acceptance. Mean concurrency does not prove tail latency. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Inspect percentiles for burst workloads. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「成本模型」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「建立假想量價表。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「SLO 驗收」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「平均並行不足以證明尾端延遲。」。
提交「SLO 驗收」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「對突發工作負載看分位數。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit cost model input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit slo acceptance two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit slo acceptance input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：Little 法則平均量可保證 p99 延遲。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Little’s-law averages guarantee p99 latency. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
guides.scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.
